business.name: TechNest Electronics
business.hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.

greeting.response: Hello! Welcome to TechNest support. I can help with business hours, shipping, returns, warranty, payments and products.

shipping.response: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery (1-2 days) is available for an extra fee. Orders above Rs. 999 ship free.

returns.response: You can return unused items within 14 days of delivery. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

warranty.response: All products carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Keep your invoice - it is required for warranty claims.

payment.response: We accept UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and Cash on Delivery. No-cost EMI is available on orders above Rs. 5,000.

products.response: We sell laptops, smartphones, headphones and accessories. Visit the Products page for live prices, or tell me which category you want.

contact.response: You can reach us at {phone} or {email}.

order_status.response: To track an order, share your order ID in the format TN-12345 and I will look it up.
